Root cause was NOT a broken auto-flush. The repo migrated to Dolt on 2026-05-28 (last issues.jsonl commit f2caf01), so the tracked JSONL froze at a 23-issue snapshot by design while the DB grew to 77. The 'closures live only in local DB' risk was real only until the Dolt remote was repointed to the fork (ldui-e8o) -- 'bd dolt push' now backs everything up off-machine. Resolution: refreshed .beads/issues.jsonl to the current 77-issue state via 'bd export' and committed it (665acd4) as a human-readable/PR-visible snapshot. Going forward it's a manual convenience mirror ('bd export --output .beads/issues.jsonl' when git should reflect current state); the authoritative backup is 'bd dolt push'. Verified DB intact after export (open beads unchanged).
